svg.title: How Improvado MCP works
svg.desc: Diagram: your AI client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, Gemini CLI, Codex or any MCP client) connects over MCP to Improvado MCP, a hosted remote server with OAuth sign-in that applies your workspace permissions, which reads marketing data from the sources connected to your Improvado workspace, for example Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Analytics 4, HubSpot, Salesforce and Shopify, out of 1,400+ supported sources. Three steps: add the server URL in your client, sign in with Improvado, ask questions in plain language.
